name: Street Glide 01
tagline: Soft suede layering with everyday cushioning.
description: A modern low-top built for long city days, with plush foam underfoot and textured suede panels that keep the silhouette polished without feeling too formal.

name: Courtline Luxe
tagline: Minimal lines, premium leather, sharp profile.
description: Courtline Luxe keeps things crisp with smooth leather, contrast stitching, and a gum outsole that works beautifully with denim, cargos, and relaxed tailoring.

name: Velocity Knit
tagline: Light on foot with all-day breathability.
description: Designed for quick morning runs and busy afternoons, this pair uses an airy knit upper and a responsive midsole that keeps every step feeling springy and controlled.

name: Harbor Retro
tagline: Retro shape with modern comfort inside.
description: Harbor Retro leans into old-school trainer cues with a slimmer profile, tactile nubuck overlays, and a cushioned footbed that feels much more current than the look suggests.

name: Pulse Runner X
tagline: Energy return tuned for daily training.
description: With a propulsive rocker sole, breathable mesh shell, and secure TPU support, Pulse Runner X is made for runners who want pace-day energy in an everyday trainer.

name: Mono Slip
tagline: Clean, lightweight, and easy to wear anywhere.
description: Mono Slip is made for low-effort styling, combining a soft stretch-knit upper, flexible sole, and streamlined shape that slips on quickly and feels light through the day.
